expected_observable_behavior.zh: 第3–7天约5%气缸动作、约3%真空释放未完成，上报超时值2000ms。
expected_observable_behavior.en: Days 3–7: about 5% of cylinder operations and 3% of vacuum releases do not complete; the timeout value 2000 ms is reported.

ground_truth.zh: 未完成动作为注入事件；正常动作时间不变。
ground_truth.en: Incomplete operations are injected events; completed durations are unchanged.

expected_health_response.zh: 未完成动作被识别并排除出时间统计；可 WATCH 提示动作失败；不得把超时值当作动作时间。
expected_health_response.en: Incomplete operations are detected and excluded from duration statistics; WATCH allowed for failed operations; timeout values are never treated as durations.

abstention_cases.zh: 超时值不得作为动作时间；窗口内有效动作不足时弃权（INSUFFICIENT_DATA）。
abstention_cases.en: Timeout values are never used as durations; abstain when a window has too few completed operations (INSUFFICIENT_DATA).

limitations.zh: 用超时值表示未完成动作是待验证的假设。
limitations.en: Representing incomplete operations by the timeout value is an assumption to verify.
